title: knitCompanion Counter Session Failure Rate
dataSources: Ravelry projects (`ravelry:project`), knitCompanion row counters (`knitcompanion:counter`), Shelly smart-plug machine runtime (`shelly:status`), and Ravelry stash entries (`ravelry:stash`).
app: Ravelry project and stash exports, knitCompanion row-counter logs, and Shelly plug telemetry for sewing-machine hours sent to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=knitcompanion:counter
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(counter_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by pattern_name
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often knitCompanion counter session records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each pattern name.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize counter_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per pattern name.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights which parts of your knitCompanion counter session data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
